fullPassage: Nathan boarded the train on Saturday evening. As he made his way to his seat, he found someone already sitting there. Confused, he checked his ticket and realized his mistake — it was for Sunday, not Saturday! A flush of panic spread across his face. He quickly approached a train attendant and explained the situation. 'Is there anything I can do to resolve this?' Nathan asked. 'Don't worry, sir. We still have seats available,' the attendant said with a reassuring smile. Nathan exchanged his old ticket for a new one, his worries melting away. Settling into his seat, he let out a deep breath, feeling the tension in his shoulders ease as the train began to move.

questions.passage: Nathan (A)[boarded / departed] the train on Saturday evening. As he made his way to his seat, he found someone already sitting there. (B)[Confused / Relieved], he checked his ticket and (C)[realized / forgot] his mistake.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Nathan은 토요일 저녁 기차에 탑승했다(boarded). 혼란스러워(Confused) 표를 확인하고 실수를 깨달았다(realized).
det.analysis:
✅ ① boarded — Confused — realized: 원문과 일치
❌ ② departed(출발하다): boarded의 반의어
❌ ③ Relieved(안도한): Confused의 반의어
❌ ④ forgot(잊었다): realized의 반의어

questions.passage: A flush of (A)[panic / relief] spread across his face. He quickly (B)[approached / avoided] a train attendant. 'We still have seats (C)[available / occupied],' the attendant said.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 당황(panic)이 얼굴에 퍼졌고, 승무원에게 다가갔다(approached). 좌석이 이용 가능하다(available)고 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② panic — approached — available: 원문과 일치
❌ ① relief(안도): 이 시점에서는 당황 상태
❌ ③ avoided(피했다): approached의 반의어
❌ ④ occupied(점유된): available의 반의어

questions.passage: Nathan (A)[exchanged / discarded] his old ticket for a new one, his worries (B)[melting / building] away. Settling into his seat, he felt the (C)[tension / excitement] in his shoulders ease.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Nathan은 표를 교환하고(exchanged), 걱정이 녹아 없어졌다(melting). 어깨의 긴장(tension)이 풀렸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ exchanged — melting — tension: 원문과 일치
❌ ① discarded(버렸다): 교환이지 버리는 것이 아님
❌ ② building(쌓이는): melting의 반의어
❌ ④ excitement(흥분): tension의 반의어
det.tip: exchange(교환하다), melt away(녹아 없어지다), tension(긴장) ↔ excitement(흥분)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 tension이 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: tension은 여기서 '근육의 긴장, 스트레스로 인한 신체적 뻣뻣함'을 의미한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② physical stiffness caused by stress(스트레스로 인한 신체적 경직): 어깨의 긴장이 풀림
❌ ① a strained political relationship(긴장된 정치적 관계): 정치와 무관
❌ ③ the tightness of a rope(줄의 팽팽함): 물리적 줄이 아님
❌ ④ nervous excitement before a show(공연 전 설렘): 공연과 무관
det.tip: tension: ① 긴장(심리) ② 근육 경직(신체) ③ 팽팽함(물리) — 여기서는 ②
